titles: Why Part of Minnesota Is Trapped in Canada
The US Territory Cut Off From America

description:

facts.claim: The 1783 Treaty of Paris set the border based on mapping errors.
The Northwest Angle has a total population of 149 at the 2020 Census.
The Northwest Angle is the only place in the contiguous US north of the 49th parallel.
The distance from Warroad to the Angle is about 63 miles through Manitoba.
The Northwest Angle is the setting for the Danny Orlis mystery book series.
